# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(BiocParallel)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR    <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT  <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
CAND_DIR      <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "candidates")
OUT_SCORE_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores", "tad_scores")
dir.create(OUT_SCORE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
CTCF_chip <- "/mnt/germain/datasets/ENCODE/chip"

celltypes_tsv <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "celltypes.tsv")
ctcf_rds <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "CTCF_aggregated.GR.rds")

out_dir_n <- file.path(OUT_SCORE_DIR, "n_tad_boundaries_crossed")
out_dir_sum <- file.path(OUT_SCORE_DIR, "sum_tad_scores")
out_dir_pyth <- file.path(OUT_SCORE_DIR, "pythagorean_tad_scores")

dir.create(out_dir_n, TRUE, TRUE)
dir.create(out_dir_sum, TRUE, TRUE)
dir.create(out_dir_pyth, TRUE, TRUE)
```

# 3. Prepare CTCF sites
```{r}
if (file.exists(ctcf_rds)){
  ctcf <- readRDS(ctcf_rds)
  ctcf_pt <- resize(ctcf, width = 1, fix = "center")
} else {
  lf <- list.files(CTCF_chip, pattern="_CTCF_", recursive = TRUE, full=TRUE)
  writeLines(lf, "CTCF_aggregated_srcFiles.txt")
  
  p <- lapply(lf, \(x){
    x <- rtracklayer::import(x, format="NarrowPeak")
    g <- granges(x)
    g$score <- x$signalValue
    g
  })
  
  p <- unlist(GRangesList(p))
  pr <- reduce(p, with.revmap=TRUE)
  
  p2 <- bplapply(pr$revmap, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(20, progress=TRUE), FUN=function(x){
    g <- p[x]
    GRanges(as.character(seqnames(g)[1]), IRanges(round(median(start(g))), round(median(end(g)))),
            meanScore=mean(g$score), maxScore=max(g$score), sumScore=sum(g$score), pythScore=sqrt(sum(g$score^2)))
  })
  p2 <- unlist(GRangesList(p2))
  p2 <- sort(p2)
  p2 <- p2[which(p2$maxScore>=5)]
  saveRDS(p2, file="CTCF_aggregated.GR.rds")
  
}
```

```{r}
keys_df <- read.delim(celltypes_tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
col_key <- if ("celltype_key" %in% names(keys_df)) "celltype_key" else names(keys_df)[1]
keys <- unique(trimws(keys_df[[col_key]]))
keys <- keys[!is.na(keys) & nzchar(keys)]


for (ct in keys) {
  cand_tsv <- file.path(candidates_dir, paste0("candidates_", ct, ".tsv"))
  message(cand_tsv)
  if (!file.exists(cand_tsv)) {
    message("Missing candidates for ", ct, ": ", cand_tsv)
    next
  }
  
  L <- fread(cand_tsv)
  if (!nrow(L)) {
    message("Empty candidates for ", ct)
    next
  }
  
  L <- L[peak_chr == gene_chr]
  if (!nrow(L)) {
    message("No matching peaks")
  }
  
  left <- pmin(L$peak_start, L$peak_end, L$tss)
  right <- pmax(L$peak_start, L$peak_end, L$tss)
  has <- (right - left) > 1L
  seg_gr <- GRanges(L$peak_chr[has], IRanges(left[has] + 1L, right[has] - 1L))
  
  counts <- integer(nrow(L))
  if (length(seg_gr)) counts[has] <- countOverlaps(seg_gr, ctcf_pt)
  res_n <- data.table(peak = L$peak_id, gene_id = L$gene_id, score = counts)
  
  ov <- if (length(seg_gr)) findOverlaps(seg_gr, ctcf_pt) else Hits()
  
  # sumScore
  DT_sum <- if (length(ov)) data.table(idx = queryHits(ov),
                                       v = mcols(ctcf_pt)$sumScore[subjectHits(ov)])
  else data.table(idx=integer(), v=numeric())
  agg_sum <- DT_sum[, .(score = sum(v, na.rm = TRUE)), by = idx]
  res_sum <- data.table(peak = L$peak_id, gene_id = L$gene_id, score = 0)
  if (nrow(agg_sum)) {
    map <- which(has)[agg_sum$idx]
    set(res_sum, i = map, j = "score", value = agg_sum$score)
  }
  
  # pythScore
  DT_pyth <- if (length(ov)) data.table(idx = queryHits(ov),
                                        v = mcols(ctcf_pt)$pythScore[subjectHits(ov)])
  else data.table(idx=integer(), v=numeric())
  agg_pyth <- DT_pyth[, .(score = sum(v, na.rm = TRUE)), by = idx]
  res_pyth <- data.table(peak = L$peak_id, gene_id = L$gene_id, score = 0)
  if (nrow(agg_pyth)) {
    map <- which(has)[agg_pyth$idx]
    set(res_pyth, i = map, j = "score", value = agg_pyth$score)
  }
  
  fwrite(res_n, file.path(out_dir_n, paste0("n_boundaries_crossed_", ct, ".tsv")), sep="\t")
  fwrite(res_sum, file.path(out_dir_sum, paste0("sum_boundary_sumScore_", ct, ".tsv")), sep="\t")
  fwrite(res_pyth, file.path(out_dir_pyth, paste0("pythagorean_TAD_score_", ct, ".tsv")), sep="\t")
  
  message("Done: ", ct, " (", nrow(L), " links)")
}
```
